narrative: The plot of Richard II on its peg by the tiring-house door, the entrances in Garnish's hand. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the door, and did not take the plot down.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: His hand on the entrances. He is not in the picture.

entities.name: Richard the Second
entities.context: In photo: The plot on its peg
